AGENDA
  GLENDALE AUDIT COMMITTEE
  MUNICIPAL SERVICES BUILDING
  633 E. Broadway, Room 105
  Glendale, CA 91206
Meetings are broadcast live on Glendale TV, viewable on Spectrum Cable, channel 6, and AT&T U-
verse, channel 99. Meetings are also streamed live in high definition (HD) on the city's webpage,
glendaleca.gov/live, on YouTube.com/myglendale, and on Apple TV, Roku, and Amazon Fire
devices using a free app called Screenweave and choosing “Glendale TV” from the menu. Meetings
are also archived on the City Website for viewing anytime at glendaleca.gov/agendas. Call (818)
548-4013 for program schedules. DVDs of the proceedings are available for purchase in the City
Clerk's Office. Audit Reports are available for viewing by clicking here. For public comments and
questions during the meeting, call (818) 937-8100. Public comments on a specific agenda item will
be taken when that agenda item is discussed. If you have any question about matters on the
agenda, or requests for assistance, please contact the Management Services Department at (818)
548-4844, during regular business hours.
  PLEASE TURN OFF CELLULAR PHONES WHILE INSIDE THE MEETING LOCATION
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) of 1990, auxiliary hearing aids, sign
language translation, and Braille transcripts are available upon request. Assisted listening devices
are available same-day upon request. At least 48 hours (or two business days) notice is required for
requests regarding sign language translation and Braille transcription services. All documents
related to open session items on this agenda that are received less than 72 hours prior to this
meeting, and are public records, will be available for review in the Office of the City Clerk, 613 E.
Broadway, RM 110, Glendale, CA 91206.
Translation services are provided for meetings through the use of bilingual staff for speakers who
wish to utilize the service as available. Speakers should state their request by contacting the City
Clerk’s office at (818) 548-2090, at least 24 hours prior to the scheduled meeting. Please specify
the language for which you require translation. The exclusive use of City provided interpreters is not
required and persons are welcome to use their own interpreter or speak in their native language.

CITY OF GLENDALE
  AUDIT COMMITTEE MINUTES
  April 27, 2023

1.  ROLL CALL: 2:00 PM
  Present: Edwin Belen, Edmund Khashadourian, Jack Mavyan, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy
  Absent: Alejandro Parajon
2.  BUSINESS AGENDA:
  A. Posting of Agenda
  The Agenda for the Audit Committee meeting of April 27, 2023 was posted on
  April 24, 2023, on the Bulletin Board outside City Hall.
  B. Appreciation Ceremony of Outgoing Audit Committee Chair
  Mr. Zareh Amirian expressed appreciation to City staff and fellow Committee
  members for making his thirteen years of service to the Audit Committee a
  productive and pleasant experience. Mr. Amirian thanked Internal Audit staff for
  promoting the integrity, accountability, and efficiency of City operations. Mr.
  Amirian also thanked City Management for their collaboration and support and
  his fellow Committee members, both past and present, for their camaraderie and
  support.
  Mr. Edmund Khashadourian expressed appreciation for Mr. Amirian’s many
  years of service to the Committee and support to Committee Members.
  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, thanked the outgoing Audit
  Committee Chair for his years of dedicated service to the Committee.
3.  ORAL COMMUNICATIONS:

  None.

5.  ACTION ITEMS:

  Note: Agenda Item 5A was taken out of order and presented first.

  1
   A. A motion was made to postpone the election of the Audit Committee Chair to
  the next meeting when there will be a full panel of members; and Mr. Edmund
  Khashadourian was selected as the Chair Pro-Tem to preside over this meeting.

  Moved: Edmund Khashadourian Seconded: Thomas O’Shaughnessy
  Vote as follows:
  Ayes: Edward Belen, Jack Mavyan, Edmund Khashadourian, Thomas
  O’Shaughnessy

  Noes: None
  Absent: Alejandro Parajon
  Abstain: None

4.  APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

  A. Minutes of the Audit Committee meeting held on January 26, 2023

  Approval of minutes were continued to the next meeting when additional
  committee members will be present.

6.  REPORTS – INFORMATION:

  A. Internal Audit Activity Report as of 3/31/2023 – Jessie Zhang, Internal
  Audit Manager

  Ms. Jessie Zhang, Internal Audit Manager, provided a report to the Audit
  Committee on the Internal Audit activity for the quarter ended on March 31, 2023.
  Ms. Ani Antanesyan, Sr. Internal Auditor, made a presentation on the Scholl
  Canyon Landfill JPA Host Fees and Lease Payments Audit. Ms. Antanesyan and
  Mr. Maurice Oillataguerre, Environmental Services Administrator answered
  questions from Committee members.
  Ms. Minami-Valdivia, Sr. Internal Auditor, made a presentation on PCI
  Compliance Audit. Ms. Minami-Valdivia and Ms. Guia Murray, Assistant City
  Treasurer answered questions from Committee members.
  After the audit presentation, Ms. Zhang continued presenting the Internal Audit
  activity report for the quarter. She covered projects in progress, continuous
  audits, quarterly follow-up status on outstanding audit issues, and advisory
  services and answered questions from the Committee members.
7.  AUDIT COMMITTEE/STAFF COMMENTS:

  Ms. Zhang welcomed the new Audit Committee member Edward Belen, and the
  returning Committee member Thomas O’Shaughnessy.

  2
   Committee member Thomas O’Shaughnessy inquired whether there are any
  materials or training that he can review as a returning committee member. Mr.
  John Takhtalian, Assistant City Manager replied that keeping apprised of City
  Council proceedings and reviewing Citywide reports, such as financial reports will
  be helpful.
8.  NEW BUSINESS:

  Committee member Edmund Khashadourian requested that Ms. Lucy Varpetian,
  Principal Assistant City Attorney provide a presentation on the Brown Act. Ms.
  Lucy Varpetian responded that the City systematically provides this training to all
  committees with new members, and she will provide an update on the training
  schedule at the next meeting.

9.  ADJOURNMENT:

  Moved: Thomas O’Shaughnessy Seconded: Jack Mavyan

  Adjournment at 3:41 PM
